mgh.label: Old official link list broken
mgh.detail: massgeneral.org/cms-hpt.txt now redirects to a regular web page, and the file link it used to give returns 404. The current list is at massgeneralbrigham.org/cms-hpt.txt.

mgh.label: Automated download works
mgh.detail: Downloaded from the current Mass General Brigham link.

mgh.label: 2 of 18 procedures not listed
mgh.detail: No price for cataract surgery or knee arthroscopy (meniscus) under standard codes; in Mass General Brigham, eye surgery is likely done at Mass Eye and Ear, which publishes its own file. The gallbladder-removal hospital stay is priced for Medicare plans only, so there's no commercial comparison.

bmc.label: Many rates without an amount paid
bmc.detail: 547 insurer rates are set by a formula with no amount-paid figure, so they can't be compared fairly and are left out of comparisons.

bmc.label: Gallbladder-removal hospital stay not listed
bmc.detail: No price under the standard inpatient code (MS-DRG 419).

bidmc.label: Only 6 insurers listed for outpatient procedures
bidmc.detail: For the 17 outpatient procedures compared, the file lists only 6 insurers; Aetna, UnitedHealthcare and Tufts Health Plan appear only for the gallbladder-removal hospital stay. Either outpatient prices for them are missing or recorded in a form not yet handled.
